title: SOS: DELETE silent-drop gates have zero test coverage
description: Found by codereview (edge pass) on b7z9.121.3. emergency.py render_delete 的 6 个静默丢弃分支(empty payload/missing envelope/bad sig blob/non-originator key/invalid sig/replay, ~L334-366)无任何测试;_expect_silent_drop 硬编码 POST 无法复用,需加 code/uri 参数或 DELETE 专用断言。回归(如恢复 4.01、idle 检查顺序变化)不会被发现。
close_reason: Added TestSosDeleteGates (10 tests) to python/tests/coap/test_sos_resource.py covering the full DELETE /sos gate ladder in render_delete: empty payload 4.01, invalid CBOR 4.00, non-dict CBOR 4.00, missing envelope 4.01, mistyped envelope fields (str/31B pubkey, int sig) 4.01, malformed sig blob 4.01, wrong-key binding 4.01, tampered sig 4.01, replay 4.01 + advance-cancels, and rejection-does-not-consume-sequence. 121 SOS tests pass; ruff + mypy clean. Codereview: pass1 correctness PASS; pass2 security (timeout once, then PASS) found 1 real gap (no seq non-consumption pin) -> fixed inline with test_delete_rejection_does_not_consume_sequence (finding was against this bead's own new code, so fixed here rather than filing a twin); pass3 edge found 1 gap (envelope sub-branches untested) -> fixed inline with test_delete_mistyped_envelope_fields_rejected; convergence re-review PASS, no new findings.
